summary: test_detail_pane_shows_copy_key_hint_without_changing_copyable_detail asserts the real Textual-rendered Rich Text ends with exactly '\nc: copy details  y: copy slug  Y: copy id' and that this exact span is fully dim (start==hint_start, end==len(plain), style.dim); mutation-tested by temporarily changing style to bold, altering spacing, and appending trailing content after the hint — all three were correctly rejected by the test, then reverted with no residual diff.
